agents.detail.emptyPrompt: (no system prompt — click Edit to draft one)
agents.detail.connectionsHint: Session sees only these sources when this agent is active (intersected with the session-level whitelist if any).
agents.detail.toolsHint: SDK toolset restricted to this whitelist (Options.allowedTools).
agents.creator.title: Create agent
agents.creator.subtitle: Chat to draft an AGENT.md
agents.creator.hint: Describe the agent you want — its role, personality, and when it should be used. The assistant drafts an AGENT.md (system prompt + metadata) and writes it to the chosen scope.
agents.creator.placeholder: e.g. A security reviewer that audits diffs against the AWOG invariants…
agents.creator.iterate: Refine the agent — tweak the prompt, model, or role…
agents.editor.roleHint: Short label shown on the avatar (optional).
agents.editor.name: Name
agents.editor.descPh: When to use this agent — one sentence shown in pickers.
agents.editor.descHint: Required by the Claude Code subagent format.
agents.editor.accountHint: Which account this agent uses. The active account = unpinned — sessions follow the project's LLM defaults then the provider's active account; a different choice pins it for every project.
agents.editor.systemPromptPh: You are a… Define the agent's role, personality, and how it should approach tasks.
agents.editor.toolsHint: Empty = full toolset. Add mcp__<id> to allow a source's tools.
agents.editor.connectionsEmpty: No sources yet — add one on the Sources page.
agents.editor.connectionsHint: Unticked = inherit the session's sources. Tick to restrict this agent to a whitelist.
agents.editor.skillsEmpty: No skills yet — add one on the Skills page.
agents.editor.skillsHint: Unticked = agent sees every in-scope skill. Tick to restrict it to a whitelist (filters the skills catalogue and the runtime Skill tool).
agents.editor.reposHint: Unticked = unrestricted (the session's workspace). Tick to scope file access to these repositories; add a free-form path for a sub-repo inside a project.
agents.bodyEdit.title: Edit {id}.md
agents.bodyEdit.hint: Describe what should change — the instructions are revised and the AI may suggest skills/tools from your catalog (review the ticks before applying); sources and repo access stay in their own tabs.
agents.bodyEdit.placeholder: e.g. "Make this more concise" or "Add a section about edge cases"
agents.bodyEdit.fullSpecHint: One click — writes the complete senior-grade spec for this role, suggests skills/tools from your catalog, then SAVES it (runs in background, toasts when done)
agents.bodyEdit.refinePh: Small tweaks, e.g. 'make section 3 shorter' or 'add escalation criteria'…
agents.bodyEdit.catalogDropped: The provider flagged the skills catalog, so this draft was generated without skill suggestions — pick them manually in the Skills tab if needed.
agents.page.title: Agents
agents.page.tagline: Reusable identities your sessions run as.
agents.empty.title: No agents yet
agents.empty.desc: Create an agent to give your sessions a persistent role.
agents.create.title: New agent
agents.create.aiDesc: Describe the goal — AI drafts the AGENT.md.
agents.detail.noSessions: No sessions are bound to this agent yet.
agents.sort.name: Name
agents.bulk.deleteDesc: Delete {n} agents? Their AGENT.md files are removed from disk. Sessions already spawned are unaffected.
